changes.name: SkyboundPetIndex
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local function hook(p)
 local pets=p:WaitForChild("Pets",15);if not pets then return end
 local function count()
  local n=#pets:GetChildren();p:SetAttribute("PetCount",n);p:SetAttribute("PetIndexPercent",math.min(100,math.floor(n/24*100)))
 end
 pets.ChildAdded:Connect(count);pets.ChildRemoved:Connect(count);count()
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.spawn(hook,p) end)

changes.name: SkyboundPetIndexUI
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players");local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="PetIndexUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(130,46);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,158,1,-70);b.Text="PET INDEX";b.TextScaled=true;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.Parent=gui
local f=Instance.new("Frame");f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(420,360);f.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-210,.5,-180);f.Visible=false;f.Parent=gui
local t=Instance.new("TextLabel");t.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,60);t.BackgroundTransparency=1;t.TextScaled=true;t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;t.Parent=f
local list=Instance.new("TextLabel");list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,70);list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-90);list.BackgroundTransparency=1;list.TextWrapped=true;list.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top;list.TextScaled=false;list.TextSize=18;list.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;list.Parent=f
local known={"Cloud Bunny","Sky Fox","Sun Cub","Storm Dragon","Bubble Bunny","River Fox","Aqua Cub","Tide Dragon","Sand Bunny","Dune Fox","Sun Lion","Pharaoh Dragon","VolcanoRealm Pet","CelestialCity Pet","VoidRealm Pet"}
local function update()
 t.Text="PET INDEX  •  "..tostring(p:GetAttribute("PetCount") or 0).." OWNED"
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");local owned={}
 if inv then for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do owned[v.Value]=true end end
 local lines={};for _,n in ipairs(known) do table.insert(lines,(owned[n] and "✓  " or "???  ")..(owned[n] and n or "UNDISCOVERED PET")) end
 list.Text=table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
b.Activated:Connect(function() f.Visible=not f.Visible;if f.Visible then update() end end)
p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetCount"):Connect(function() if f.Visible then update() end end)
